result: Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B is retained as a German-source-eligible TTS challenger. The default Transformers path requires custom remote code, but first-party Audio8 also publishes a CPU-oriented INT4 ONNX runtime with streaming PCM, explicit cancellation, local voice registration, and no PyTorch/Transformers/HF-Hub requirement after artifacts are downloaded. Linux/clay-direct-dev latency, German naturalness, stable male voice identity and cancellation-to-last-audible-sample behavior remain unmeasured.
next_exact_gate: After the retained clay-direct-dev hardware/runner gate is valid and duplicate target-TTS work is checked, acquire a distinct target-runtime semantic claim and benchmark the pinned Audio8 0.6B ONNX INT4 path against Qwen3-TTS, MagpieTTS and the ultralight local baseline on identical German voice capsules.
